apis.description: Returns the paginated list of question banks for a given context.

operations.notes: Returns the paginated list of question banks for a given context.

parameters.name: context_type
parameters.description: The type of context. Must be either "Course" or "Account".

parameters.name: include_question_count
parameters.description: Whether to include the number of questions in each bank.

apis.description: Returns the question bank with the given id

operations.notes: Returns the question bank with the given id

parameters.name: include_question_count
parameters.description: Whether to include the number of questions in the bank.

apis.description: Returns the paginated list of assessment questions in this bank.

operations.summary: List assessment questions for a question bank
operations.notes: Returns the paginated list of assessment questions in this bank.

id.description: The ID of the assessment question bank.

context_id.description: The ID of the context (course or account) the question bank belongs to.

context_type.description: The type of context (Course or Account).

title.description: The title of the question bank.

workflow_state.description: The workflow state of the question bank.

assessment_question_count.description: The number of questions in the bank.

context_code.description: The combined context type and ID.

created_at.description: The date and time the question bank was created.

updated_at.description: The date and time the question bank was last updated.

id.description: The ID of the assessment question.

assessment_question_bank_id.description: The ID of the question bank this question belongs to.

created_at.description: The date and time when the assessment question was created.

question_text.example: Which of the following is NOT a prime number?

points_possible.description: The maximum amount of points possible received for getting this question correct.

correct_comments.description: The comments to display if the student answers the question correctly.

incorrect_comments.description: The comments to display if the student answers incorrectly.
incorrect_comments.example: Unfortunately, that IS a prime number.

neutral_comments.description: The comments to display regardless of how the student answered.
neutral_comments.example: Goldbach's conjecture proposes that every even integer greater than 2 can be expressed as the sum of two prime numbers.

correct_comments_html.description: The HTML version of the comments to display if the student answers the question correctly.

incorrect_comments_html.description: The HTML version of the comments to display if the student answers incorrectly.

neutral_comments_html.description: The HTML version of the comments to display regardless of how the student answered.
neutral_comments_html.example: Goldbach's conjecture proposes that every even integer greater than 2 can be expressed as the sum of two prime numbers.

answers.description: An array of available answers. Each answer contains id, text, html, comments, comments_html, and weight properties.

html.description: The HTML version of the answer text.

comments_html.description: The HTML version of the comments for this answer.

weight.description: The weight of the answer. 100 indicates a correct answer, 0 indicates incorrect.

variables.description: Variables for calculated questions. Null for other question types.

formulas.description: Formulas for calculated questions. Null for other question types.

answer_tolerance.description: The tolerance for numerical answers. Null for non-numerical question types.

formula_decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places for formula results. Null for non-calculated question types.

matches.description: Matching pairs for matching questions. Null for other question types.

matching_answer_incorrect_matches.description: Incorrect match options for matching questions. Null for other question types.
